Once you have completed an action it can take between 24-48 hours for the changes to be
reflected in your secure score.
Ranking is based on the number of points left to achieve, implementation difficulty, user
impact, and complexity. The highest ranked recommended actions have a large number of
points remaining with low difficulty, user impact, and complexity.
When you select a specific recommended action, a full page flyout appears.
